text:
Release Bot: post-deploy synth smoke for rollout v2026.06.12 completed. Overall green but read-replica probe failed intermittently in apac-sg. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.ai/r/3961234567 :mag:
Nora: noticed a 504 spike from read-replica healthcheck (/api/v1/health/read-replica) — about 12 failures over 3 hosts at 02:17UTC. small but reproducible during the change window overlap.
QA Bot: synth-report: read-replica-check -> 504 upstream-timeout host=10.55.3.21..23, error=txn-lock-timeout, cookie=roll=v2026.06.12.
Jin: i'm on-call for apac-sg. Checking DB metrics  saw a short-lived surge in replica replication lag and a burst of rw transactions during a scheduled schema migration that overlapped the rollout window.
SRE: confirmed: migration job MIG-2204 started at 02:15UTC (scheduled), rollout started at 02:16UTC. Migration acquires a brief exclusive lock on analytics tables which caused read fallback to queue on replicas. Not a code bug but a coordination issue.
Nora: prefer to avoid rollback. Proposal: 1) pin read-heavy route /api/v1/health/read-replica in apac-sg to v2026.06.11 (previous stable) 2) increase probe timeout to 5s for v2026.06.12 variant temporarily and 3) reschedule the remaining migration steps outside the deployment window. Then rerun smoke.
deploy-bot: executing: redwood route pin --route /api/v1/health/read-replica --to v2026.06.11 --region apac-sg
deploy-bot: pin applied. Traffic to v2026.06.11 in apac-sg. :white_check_mark:
SRE: bumped probe timeout=5000ms on v2026.06.12 for the read-replica checks (temporary flag). Kicking off synth rerun.
QA Bot: synth-smoke rerun started (id ss-3961234567-2)
QA Bot: rerun complete: 200/200 checks OK, p95=58ms, no 5xx observed.
Jin: leaving pin for 45m while we finish migration reschedule and monitor replication lag + client-side error budgets. Will also add a small guard to migrations scheduler to avoid overlap with active rollouts.
Nora: opened follow-up ticket INF-10120 "migration/rollout window coordination: prevent overlap" and attached timestamps/traces. Will update release notes to call out required no-migration cooldown for 30m post-rollout.
Release Bot: rollout placed on hold; pin set for 45m. Notifying #deploy-notify.
SRE: follow-up operational change: add a preflight check to the deploy pipeline that queries active scheduled migration jobs and warns if any conflicts exist. Draft PR underway.
Nora: thanks team. Plan to unpin and fully re-enable v2026.06.12 for the route with a 10% gradual ramp after the 45m hold if metrics remain stable. :thumbsup:
